title: Implement new batch page — Tab A (paste/CSV import with parsing)
description: Implement the CSV/paste import tab on the new batch page. Accepts a textarea of CSV/TSV/one-per-line data, parses it into a prospect table preview, detects duplicates, and allows editing before submitting.
acceptanceCriteria: Tab A has a textarea for paste input and a 'Parse' button
Parse button converts the input into a preview table
Table columns: business_name, industry, location, phone, email, existing_url, notes
Duplicate rows (same business_name + industry) are highlighted with a warning
Industry field has a dropdown selector in the preview table
Submit creates the batch and all prospects via the API
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component. Render batch name input, industry dropdown (for the batch), then shadcn/ui Tabs with 'Paste List' (Tab A) and 'Single Entry' (Tab B).

When 'Parse' is clicked: split input by newlines, detect delimiter (comma, tab, pipe). Parse each row into prospect fields. First row detection: if first row looks like headers, skip it. Handle quoted fields (CSV standard). Use `useState` to store parsed rows.
Show parsed prospects in a shadcn/ui Table. Each row is editable (input fields for each cell). Highlight duplicate rows in amber. Show row count: 'X prospects ready to import'.
'Create Batch' button: POST to /api/batches with batch name + industry. Then POST to /api/prospects with all parsed prospects. On success, navigate to /batches/[newBatchId].
Take Playwright screenshot. Paste a sample CSV, click Parse, verify table renders. Submit and verify redirect to batch detail page.

technicalNotes: The CSV parser should handle: comma-separated, tab-separated, and one-per-line (business names only, with industry inferred from batch industry).
Required fields: business_name. All other fields optional — empty cells are fine.
Consider using a small CSV parsing library (csv-parse) rather than rolling a custom one.
